description: Source code for QuicChaosProtector class implementing packet manipulation and obfuscation in QUIC protocol.

classes.name: QuicChaosProtector
classes.description: Class responsible for obfuscating and manipulating QUIC data packets by adding padding, splitting crypto frames, and reordering frames.

methods.name: QuicChaosProtector
methods.description: Constructor initializing the chaos protector with crypto frame, padding, packet size, framer, and random generator.

methods.name: BuildDataPacket
methods.description: Builds a data packet with obfuscation, padding, and frame reordering.

methods.name: WriteStreamData
methods.description: Method that should not be called; indicates a chaos stream.

methods.name: WriteCryptoData
methods.description: Writes crypto data to a buffer, ensuring correct offsets and lengths.

methods.name: CopyCryptoDataToLocalBuffer
methods.description: Serializes crypto frame data into a local buffer for manipulation.

methods.name: SplitCryptoFrame
methods.description: Splits crypto frames into smaller frames randomly to obfuscate data.

methods.name: AddPingFrames
methods.description: Adds ping frames as padding to increase obfuscation.

methods.name: ReorderFrames
methods.description: Randomly reorders frames to obfuscate frame order.

methods.name: SpreadPadding
methods.description: Distributes remaining padding bytes across frames.

methods.name: BuildPacket
methods.description: Builds the final packet with the manipulated frames.
